briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and xAI Colossus cluster intensify AGI deployment race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid escalating compute investments. Prompt injection attacks continue to target production deployments while regulatory scrutiny grows in the EU and US. The AGI race shows no signs of slowing as new infrastructure comes online.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus; xAI activated Colossus v2 training run; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant; DeepSeek-V3.5 achieved new efficiency benchmarks. Google Gemini 2.5 Ultra entered internal testing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST issued new guidelines on agentic AI risks while several startups reported zero-day exploits in multi-agent frameworks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced $8B expansion of its Texas AI supercluster; TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips; CoreWeave secured additional power contracts for European data centers; Amazon revealed custom Trainium3 chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first publicly acknowledged AGI-level system emerge from a US or Chinese lab before 2028?
